neha: good morning — quick shift wrap / handoff
neha: backlog at start: 48 tickets (P0:0, P1:2, P2:6, P3:40) — trending slightly up vs last shift :chart_with_upwards_trend:
neha: known issue: some customers in eu-west are seeing delayed embedding indexing (~5–10m). eng-infra alerted and looking at ingestion queue lag. linking the incident here: https://redwood.internal/ops/INGEST-412
sam: I can pick up any escalations for eu-west until 11:30am PT. ping @eng-infra if you need trace dumps.
maria: FYI I'm rolling a small macro patch for refunds that replaces the old `refund_v1` with `refund_v2`. Will post PR in #eng-releases in a sec. No customer-facing changes expected besides messaging tweak.
eli: small heads up — a customer's webhook failed to ack and generated duplicates. I left a note on ticket 98412 with the mitigation steps (disabled retries).
neha: macros to use this shift: `reply-ack`, `refund-v2`, `embed-lag-explain`. Use `refund-v2` only after confirming invoice id.
neha: ops checklist for next 30m: 1) confirm P1s have owners, 2) check eu-west ingest dashboard, 3) run quick search for any duplicate webhooks.
sam: Assigned P1s: 98021 -> sam, 98200 -> maria. Taking 98021 now.
maria: PR for macro patch: https://github.com/redwood/support-macros/pull/88 — small change, tests passing. Will merge on ✅ from @devops-bot.
devops-bot: deploy scheduled to canary at 1725256500. Will report status here.
neha: customer comm snippets: for embedding delay, use: "We're seeing a short delay in indexing for EU customers; engineers are investigating and expected resolution within ~30 minutes. Apologies for the inconvenience." Use `embed-lag-explain` macro for consistency.
eli: quick note — I added a temporary tag `needs-replay` on 3 webhooks to track follow-ups.
sam: if anyone sees a spike in requeue count, call me or drop in #eng-oncall.
neha: end of handoff: leaving notes on 98021 and 98200. Back at 16:00 PT for async wrap. :coffee:
